claim: The General Court assembles every year on the first Wednesday after the first Tuesday in January
quote: shall assemble annually on the first Wednesday following the first Tuesday in January

claim: A bill not returned within five days (Sundays excepted) becomes law
quote: five days (Sundays excepted) after it shall have been presented to him, the same shall be a law in like manner as if he had signed it

claim: If adjournment prevents the return of a bill, it does not become law
quote: unless the legislature, by their adjournment, prevent its return, in which case it shall not be a law

claim: Laws take effect 60 days after passage unless the act sets another date
quote: each law passed by the general court shall take effect 60 calendar days following passage

claim: The state general election is the Tuesday after the first Monday in November of even-numbered years
quote: The state general election shall be held on the first Tuesday following the first Monday in November of every even-numbered year

claim: The state primary is the second Tuesday in September of even-numbered years
quote: The state primary election shall be held on the second Tuesday in September of every even-numbered year

claim: A state general election chooses federal, state and county officers
quote: shall mean an election to choose a federal, state, or county officer

claim: Sheriff, county attorney, treasurer, register of deeds and register of probate are elected at each state general election for 2-year terms, 4 years in Rockingham and Coos
quote: One sheriff, one county attorney, one county treasurer, one register of deeds, and one register of probate by the voters in each county

claim: County officers have 2-year terms except as provided
quote: At every state general election, the following officers shall be elected for 2-year terms except as otherwise provided

claim: Rockingham and Coos county officers serve 4-year terms
quote: any such officer in Coos county shall be chosen in the county by the voters for a 4-year term

claim: Each county commissioner is elected from a commissioner district, by district voters or the whole county depending on the county
quote: one county commissioner by those voters in each county commissioner district in the county

claim: Carroll and Sullivan elect commissioners countywide
quote: Sullivan county-one county commissioner from each county commissioner district by all the voters of the county

claim: In most counties commissioner terms alternate between 4 and 2 years
quote: one shall serve a 4-year term and one shall serve a 2-year term

claim: Towns elect officers every year on the second Tuesday in March, unless they have adopted the May date or another date
quote: All towns shall hold an election annually for the election of town officers on the second Tuesday in March

claim: Charter towns may choose March, May or November of odd years
quote: the first Tuesday after the first Monday in November in odd-numbered years as the date for the election of town officers

claim: Town elections are never held with the state general election
quote: No town election shall be held in conjunction with the biennial election

claim: An SB 2 town chooses March, April or May for its election and second session
quote: whether the date for local elections and the second session shall be the second Tuesday in March, the second Tuesday in April, or the second Tuesday in May

claim: An SB 2 town votes on all questions by official ballot after a deliberative session
quote: shall utilize the official ballot for voting on all issues before the voters

claim: Adopting SB 2 takes a three-fifths majority
quote: A 3/5 majority of those voting on the question shall be required to adopt this subdivision

claim: City elections are never held with the state general election; the date is fixed by law or ordinance
quote: shall be held on such day as may be fixed by law or by ordinance of the city council but in no event shall it be held in conjunction with a biennial election

claim: A city charter sets the city election date within what RSA 44:11 permits
quote: on a date permitted for city elections in RSA 44:11 and specified in the charter

claim: School district officers are elected at town meeting or the district annual meeting
quote: School district officers shall be elected either at the town meeting as provided in RSA 671:22-26 or at an annual meeting of the district

claim: School district elections are never held with the state general election, except Concord and Laconia
quote: no election for school district officers shall be held in conjunction with the biennial election

claim: The school district annual meeting is held between March 1 and March 25 unless the district uses SB 2
quote: shall be held annually between March 1 and March 25, inclusive, or in accordance with RSA 40:13

claim: A regular school board has 3, 5, 7 or 9 members serving 3-year terms; 3 by default
quote: may have a school board of 3, 5, 7, or 9 members, as it shall determine by vote at any annual meeting. They shall serve for a term of 3 years

claim: An undeclared voter may join a party at the primary and vote its ballot
quote: A voter may also register as a member of a party at any primary by requesting to be registered as a member and voting the ballot of the party of the voter

claim: After voting, a formerly undeclared voter may return to undeclared status
quote: A voter may also register once again as an undeclared voter after voting in a primary as a registered member of a party

claim: A registered party member who changes registration at the primary may not vote any party ballot there
quote: but he shall not be permitted in such case to vote the ballot of any party at such primary

claim: Registered voters may not change party in the months before the primary
quote: shall affiliate with a party or disaffiliate from a party between the first Wednesday in June and the day before the state primary election

claim: A town may adopt the partisan official ballot system for town officers
quote: Any town may vote to adopt the partisan official ballot system for election of town officers

claim: A town may adopt the nonpartisan official ballot system for town officers
quote: A town may vote to adopt the non-partisan official ballot system for election of town officers

claim: A town with no official ballot system elects officers by unofficial ballot at the town meeting, by majority vote
quote: A majority vote shall be required to elect using unofficial ballots

claim: Plurality elects under the partisan and nonpartisan ballot systems
quote: A plurality shall elect in towns using the non-partisan ballot system

claim: Nonpartisan town candidates file a declaration of candidacy with the town clerk
quote: all candidates shall file a declaration of candidacy with the town clerk during the filing period for town candidates

claim: Every school district uses the nonpartisan ballot system unless a special statute applies
quote: shall use the non-partisan ballot system for the election of district officers

claim: A city charter may provide for party-ballot (Australian) elections or nonpartisan elections
quote: Under charters providing for non-partisan elections, the ballot shall contain the names in alphabetical order

claim: Nonpartisan city ballots carry no party designation
quote: without party designation, of all who file with the city clerk as candidates for elective office

claim: State and county winners are those with the highest number of votes
quote: those persons who received the highest number of votes cast for said office

claim: A candidate may reach the general election ballot by nomination papers instead of a party primary
quote: As an alternative to nomination by party primary, a candidate may have his or her name placed on the ballot for the state general election by submitting the requisite number of nomination papers

claim: No voter may sign more than one nomination paper per office
quote: No voter shall sign more than one nomination paper for each office to be voted for

claim: Nomination papers may be signed only by voters registered for the state general election
quote: Nomination papers shall be signed by such persons only as are registered to vote at the state general election

claim: A candidate who filed in the primary cannot then run by nomination papers
quote: No person who filed as a candidate in the state primary election shall be eligible to have his or her name placed on the ballot for the state general election by submitting nomination papers

claim: New Hampshire has 10 counties
quote: The state is divided into 10 counties

claim: The county convention is made up of the county state representatives
quote: The county convention consists of the state representatives of the representative districts of the county

claim: Every town elects a selectman each year for a 3-year term
quote: shall choose, by ballot, one selectman to hold office for 3 years

claim: Voters may enlarge the board of selectmen to 5
quote: Are you in favor of increasing the board of selectmen to 5 members?

claim: Towns elect selectmen, moderator, supervisors of the checklist, town clerk, treasurer and highway agents by ballot
quote: The town officers specified in this section shall be elected at a town election by the voters of the town

claim: Town clerk is one of the required elected offices
quote: Town clerk (RSA 41:16 through 16-b)

claim: Optional elected offices include trustees of trust funds, library trustees and others
quote: Trustees of trust fund (RSA 31:19-23)

claim: Any town or city may adopt a charter under the home rule powers of Part I, article 39
quote: Any incorporated town or city, regardless of population, shall be entitled to exercise the home rule powers recognized by article 39, part first, of the New Hampshire constitution

claim: A charter town is prepared under RSA 49-D and a charter city under RSA 49-C
quote: If the proposed charter denominates the municipality as a city, the charter shall be prepared pursuant to RSA 49-C

claim: The governing body, mode of election and terms cannot be changed by ordinance
quote: No change in the composition, mode of election or terms of office of the legislative body, the mayor or the manager of any municipality may be accomplished by bylaw or ordinance

claim: A city charter sets terms and ward or at-large representation
quote: Terms of elected officials, the date of commencement, and termination of office and ward and at-large representation shall be set forth in the charter

claim: A charter city has a mayor and aldermen or a council-manager plan
quote: under the council-manager plan shall be a city council, all of whom shall be elected

claim: Village districts may be formed within towns for purposes such as fire protection
quote: The extinguishment of fires

claim: A village district chooses its officers at its meetings
quote: choose necessary officers therefor to hold office until the first annual meeting of the district

claim: The Concord union school district and Laconia board of education are the exceptions to the no-November rule
quote: shall not apply to the election of the board of education members of the Concord union school district
